traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum caudatum (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): surfaces adaxially glabrous or sparsely appressed-hirsute (strigose), neither said to be the more usual.

traits.leaf_hairs_beneath.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum caudatum (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): surfaces abaxially sparsely appressed-hirsute, at least proximally (strigose).

traits.stem_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum caudatum (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): petiole 7.5-17 cm, sparsely crisped-hirsute; read as half way between bare and crisped, so sparse. The plant has no stem above ground, so its hairs are drawn on its leaf stalks.

traits.leaf_ciliate.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum caudatum (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): marginal hairs perpendicular to margin or curved toward apex.

traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2654279), until a flora read here gives it; drawn by the kingdom's leaf-shape rules where before the blade was shaped by eye.

generator.params.basal_area.note: The leaf area its `basal` look draws on an organ 1 m long (plantc's shading-area test), so it shades with what it shows: its rosette leaves now take the species' cordate blade with its basal lobes, where before they drew the generic simple card (0.235).

generator.params.bud_area.note: The leaf area its `bud` look draws on an organ 1 m long (plantc's shading-area test), so it shades with what it shows: the bud is now its flower closed, where before it drew the fruit ovoid.

generator.params.flower_area.note: The leaf area its `flower` look draws on an organ 1 m long (visual forms Skill 1, 2026-10-14; plantc atlas), so it shades with what it shows: the look now takes its card from the taxa's characters, where before it drew the generic card (0.639).

traits.shoot_leaves.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Asarum caudatum: the rootstock bears its leaves 2 at a node. Read here as a year's growth of the rootstock, one node with its pair (inferred).

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a trailing evergreen ground cover of glossy, heart-shaped leaves in pairs, smelling of ginger; its brownish flowers hide under the leaves. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.15 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: glossy dark green leaves on green stalks, as iNaturalist photographs show them (observations 25917800, 280686655, 367588554).

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).
